items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: they just lowered the boom on Charlie Rangel

ctx.x: You don’t really want to hear what I have to say about Jesse. Oh God. He tells me when he does something wrong, it’s my fault. “You made me this way.” Because after Martin died, I told you that we saw to it that John Lewis, Jesse, all of his “crew,” shall we say – so I got to know them all fairly well. And Jesse – when Jesse screws up really badly, and I call him up and call him on it, “It’s your fault. If it hadn’t been for you, I wouldn’t be doing this.” But I know him very well. I’m concerned right now about…
Is this the race card, coming back?
